message: そこに鬼が

name: Nanaka
message: 「Want to go to Sans Souci right now?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh, sounds great! I'm totally in!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh yeah! Let's hit up Winter der Linden too... no, Burgstadt and Tricolore as well!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sweets Club, move out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, you two.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We have to go to Cafe Rose Blanche, too. And Chocolat.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I wanna eat crepes too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, guys. Hate to interrupt while you're having so much fun, but.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I know, I know! We'll treat you too, Synn! Nana-chan's paying!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, is that all? If you're coming too, Synn, I don't mind.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's...」
Gorgeous, extravagant cakes that one rarely gets to eat.

name: Synn
message: 「No, wait, what I'm trying to say is.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm gonna message home and tell them I don't need dinner!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do it, do it! Today we're gonna stuff ourselves!」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen. We're in the middle of exam week right now.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Speaking of! I have a coupon that gets us half off if we go during the promo period!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「For where? Until when?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For Sans Souci. Let's see... found it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Believe it or not, it's good until the day after tomorrow! I tucked it in my wallet and totally forgot.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Good thing you noticed!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't pretend you only heard the 'period' part! Ex-am per-i-od!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, you're a demon!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I got an email from Yumil.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「...Whoa, what a demon!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see... 'I'm fine with that, but are you guys gonna be okay for the tests?'」

name: Synn
message: 「That's hardly a demon. Not a demon at all. Sounds like a good underclassman looking out for their seniors.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Right now, to Nana-chan, anyone who hits her with reality is a demon!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uwooo! I hate tests! I hate studying! I'm gonna open a soba shop, so I don't need studying!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, Nana-chan broke.」

name: Synn
message: 「Your situation can't be much different, yet you're pretty calm, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Because I've achieved enlightenment. Sage mode, activate!」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of enlightenment is that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uwooo! Who cares about testssssss!」

name: Paqy
message: 「How pathetic.」
